org_configured.description: True once organization discount tiers, margin floors, and pipeline hygiene rules are bound.

target_currency.description: Reporting currency for multi-currency pipeline normalization.

auto_approve_max_discount_pct.description: Tier 0 maximum net discount percentage allowed without VP approval.

vp_approve_max_discount_pct.description: Tier 1 maximum net discount percentage allowed for Regional Sales VP.

deal_desk_max_discount_pct.description: Tier 2 maximum net discount percentage before CFO/Executive sign-off.

min_gross_margin_floor_pct.description: Minimum blended gross margin % before requiring CFO exception.

stage_stale_multiplier.description: Multiplier against median stage duration flagging stale deals.

max_push_count_before_flag.description: Close-date push count threshold flagging chronic slippage.

min_commit_contacts.description: Minimum active contacts required for Commit deals to avoid single-threading.

target_pipeline_coverage_x.description: Target weighted/open pipeline coverage multiple against remaining quota.

rfp_min_similarity_threshold.description: Minimum TF-IDF cosine similarity to accept a verified RFP library match.
